sources.instructions: Obtain a matching NS1 full install and native Linux server library. A server-only patch is not the complete content tree; do not substitute NS2. Stage the complete ns/ tree with maps, native libraries, models, sounds and supporting resources. Known sentinels do not prove completeness.
